decisions.reason: The existing message-199 MODIFY already captures the second V's proportional elevation basis, restrained relationship to the Hero V, selected 2% baseline, and removal of the obsolete height-options key; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The candidate already requires an exact Hero V terminal copy and precise peak alignment. The source restores those existing rules but does not change the candidate's current requirement state.

The composition already requires the second V right arm to be the only slightly elevated mid-word element. The source refines the atomic second-V behavior without necessarily changing the composition requirement.
The second V elevation refinement does not change the construction, proportions, or architectural language required for the remaining E and L letterforms.

The source Event changes the supporting second V's proportional elevation and visual role. Hero endpoint calibration is already owned by the shared endpoint-elevation Requirement and does not require duplicating a geometry update here.
The source preserves the established Option B terminal geometry and changes only endpoint elevation and second-V restraint, so the terminal-treatment state remains valid unchanged.
The second V form refinement does not alter the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or any other material-treatment attribute.
The restrained second-V treatment is consistent with the existing quiet-confidence and architectural-luxury goals but does not modify those broader brand-expression requirements.
The source does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
The second V design refinement does not change the requirement to provide final production-ready artwork.
